notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Orzhov Basilica and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.
